minute_event_order: At 00:00 UTC, compute the new daily starting equity from the synchronized 1m OPEN of positions carried from the prior minute, before any event timestamped in that minute.
Check inactivity continuously at minute resolution before allowing later events to rescue an already-expired account.
Process frozen ledger exits timestamped at the minute start using the frozen ledger exit price and debit the frozen exit-half execution cost.

Compute one common pre-entry equity snapshot at the synchronized minute OPEN after same-minute exits and before any new entry cost. All entries sharing the timestamp size from this same snapshot so symbol ordering cannot alter risk.
Open all frozen ledger entries timestamped at the minute start at the frozen ledger entry price and debit the frozen entry-half execution cost.
Apply canonical funding events using their exact millisecond timestamps. A funding event belongs to a trade only when entry_time < funding_time < exit_time, matching the original DH-03 rule.
After cash events, perform an event-time breach check using synchronized minute OPEN marks for still-open positions.
At minute end, mark all still-open positions to synchronized 1m CLOSE and perform the primary floating-equity breach check.
implementation_semantics.simultaneous_entries: Use one shared pre-entry equity snapshot for every trade with the same entry_time; do not cascade entry fees or arbitrary symbol ordering into later same-minute position sizes.
implementation_semantics.same_minute_exit_entry: Frozen exits at the minute start are processed before new entries. The only recovered cross-symbol entry+exit coincidences are exact-minute-open time exits, so this ordering matches their explicit execution semantic rather than inferring sub-minute stop/target ordering.
implementation_semantics.single_position_realized_loss_breach_com: absolute net realized trade loss > 3% of initial balance
implementation_semantics.balance_cashflows: Entry costs, exit costs, funding cashflows and realized price PnL immediately change account balance and the UTC day's realized net PnL.
implementation_semantics.trade_net_pnl_for_qualification: Realized price PnL plus the trade's funding cashflows minus its entry and exit execution costs.
implementation_semantics.consistency_denominator: Cumulative net realized account profit above the 100-unit initial balance when positive; losing days, fees and funding therefore reduce the denominator rather than being discarded.
implementation_semantics.pass_check: A proxy pass can occur only after total net realized profit is at least 10 initial-balance units, at least five qualifying UTC trading days have completed, and the largest positive realized UTC day is no more than 40% of cumulative net realized profit. The challenge stops at the first qualifying pass.
implementation_semantics.inactivity: Clock starts at the first setup entry and resets only on a fully closed setup trade. Breach occurs at the first simulated minute for which elapsed time is strictly greater than 30 days while the challenge is still active.
implementation_semantics.history_end_without_pass_or_breach: PROXY_INSUFFICIENT because Hyro has no maximum evaluation duration and the finite 2023-2024 setup history cannot prove eventual failure or survival.
implementation_semantics.missing_required_1m_mark: PROXY_INSUFFICIENT; no forward-fill, interpolation or 15m substitution.

post_run_lock: None of these implementation semantics may be changed to rescue or worsen a proxy cell after outcomes are opened.
